relocation.source_rule: Observed cells below the player's weighted posterior-mean expected-points baseline, ordered weakest first with cell_id as the tie-breaker.
relocation.destination_rule: At least 10 attempts, at least 90% posterior certainty above the player's current mix; one supported destination is sufficient.
relocation.destination_allocation: proportional to existing usage among supported destinations, with redistribution around a universal 50% final-share cap
relocation.score_formula: 100 * baseline expected points per attempt / targeted 25% expected points per attempt

shot_fields.identity_scope: player and season identity appear only in the containing player payload

disclaimer: Results are modeled descriptive estimates based on past shots. They are not causal, do not guarantee improvement, and do not show that a hypothetical relocated attempt would be made.
future_expansion: The same frozen process may add four season folders and a season selector in a later phase; only 2025-26 is published now.
payload_inventory_note: Hashes cover the season player index and 318 player files; the manifest cannot hash itself.
